checks.name: the regional account counts leave sandbox accounts out
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.region_account_summary s where s.accounts <> (select count(*) from raw.accounts a where a.region = s.region and not a.is_sandbox)

checks.name: the regional units leave sandbox usage out
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.region_account_summary s where s.units <> (select coalesce(sum(u.units), 0) from raw.usage u join raw.accounts a using (account_id) where a.region = s.region and not a.is_sandbox)

checks.name: the directory lists every customer account
daily usage leaves sandbox accounts out
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.account_usage_daily d join raw.accounts a using (account_id) where a.is_sandbox

checks.name: daily usage keeps every customer account's days
checks.sql: select (select count(distinct (u.account_id, u.used_on)) from raw.usage u join raw.accounts a using (account_id) where not a.is_sandbox) - (select count(*) from main.account_usage_daily)
